api.researchdata.se.note: Svensk nationell datatjänst (SND), a consortium hosted by Göteborgs universitet.

endpoint.note: Skolenhetsregistret v2: school units, organisers, education providers, komvux contracts. Belongs to the units product.

label.sv: Argo Data Catalog - Alvesta ArcGIS REST Services

bibstat.kb.se.note: Per-library observations per year as an RDF Data Cube.

label.sv: National Library of Sweden Open Data Portal

dataportal.se.note: The national portal: a federation of every registered catalog, each in its own context. The federated catalogs are their own records here.

label.sv: MAX IV SciCat DOI landing pages

esv.se.note: Harvested from esv.se: the catalog was set up when the body was Ekonomistyrningsverket.

geodata.se.note: The national geodata catalog: metadata for the services and datasets of some 25 bodies, harvested by data.europa.eu as geodata-se.

label.sv: GUPEA - University of Gothenburg Publications Electronic Archive
ArcGIS server of the Eslov community (Sweden)

lastkajen.trafikverket.se.note: Trafikverket's download portal for road and rail network data; 528 of Geodataportalen's distribution links point here. Orders are placed through the web application.

endpoint.note: Token required on every call; a public token is free after registration.

miljodata.slu.se.note: National environmental monitoring measurements of water chemistry and biology, hosted by SLU.

opendata.umea.se.note: 334 datasets: 205 Umeå Energi consumption series, geodata, copies of Kolada and SCB, and some 30 original tables.

label.sv: Digital Earth Sweden OGC Web Services

patientenkat.se.note: Results of the recurring national patient surveys by region and unit. Web interface only.

pensionsmyndigheten.se/statistik.note: A Shiny web application; no API.

pweb2.slu.se.note: Lists the OffStat database, 95 tables, and appears to mirror skogsstatistik.slu.se (98 tables, same paths); the API answers 404 below the database root. Kept until the two are compared.

px.socialstyrelsen.se.note: 799 tables in two databases (E-hälsa och välfärdsteknik i kommunerna, Nationella indikatorer för hälso- och sjukvård). No reachable API: /api/v1 answers 404, /pxweb/api/v1 500.

pxweb.umea.se.note: 57 tables. The API lists the database and answers metadata, but the JSON-stat2 POST returns 404 (json-stat works) and the Befolkningsprognoser database is not exposed by the API at all.

label.sv: Swedish House of Finance National Research Data Center
Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut DiVA
Substances in Preparations in Nordic Countries (SPIN)
Institutet för språk och folkminnen DiVA

stationsregister.miljodatasamverkan.se.note: Run by Naturvårdsverket for the environmental monitoring bodies.

statistik.bra.se.note: Reported offences by type, region and period through the SolWebb web application; no API.

statistik.mcf.se.note: statistik.msb.se redirects here since MSB became MCF.

statistik.vasteras.se.note: Several databases. The API answers the database list and metadata, but the JSON-stat2 POST returns 404 while json-stat and json work.

endpoint.note: The older API to the same database; v2 is the one read.

utslappisiffror.naturvardsverket.se.note: Emissions per facility and substance from the pollutant release register. Web interface only.

vantetider.se.note: SKR's waiting-time statistics for primary and specialised care, by region and unit. Web interface only, listed among SKR's data sources for knowledge management.

vardenisiffror.se.note: Health-care quality indicators from the national quality registries and other sources, published by SKR for the regions' knowledge management. The export API went public in 2026; 1,216 indicators.
